people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; and I will make Jacob a curse, and Israel an insult.”
translations.bsb: So I will disgrace the princes of your sanctuary, and I will devote Jacob to destruction and Israel to reproach.”
translations.kjv: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.
translations.asv: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; and I will make Jacob a curse, and Israel a reviling.
